WITH site_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    zoneref,
    SUM(articount) as artifact_count
  FROM scanfeatures
  WHERE articount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY zoneref
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(artifact_count) as total
  FROM site_totals
),
shares_and_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    st.zoneref,
    st.artifact_count,
    gt.total,
    CAST(st.artifact_count AS REAL) / gt.total as share,
    AVG(CAST(st.artifact_count AS REAL) / gt.total) OVER () as avg_share
  FROM site_totals st, grand_total gt
)
SELECT 
  zoneref,
  artifact_count,
  share,
  share - avg_share as difference
FROM shares_and_avg
WHERE total IS NOT NULL AND avg_share IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 
  difference IS NULL,
  difference DESC
LIMIT 10;
